Ramadan, a significant month in the Islamic calendar, profoundly influences the values people hold dear through a multifaceted experience. In conclusion, Ramadan provides a rich environment that can shift and reinforce values through shared experiences, spiritual reflection, empathy, self-discipline, time management, family bonding, cultural immersion, personal growth, and annual repetition.
